TermTranslation.definition: A test that looks for blood in the stool that cannot be seen with the eyes.

TermTranslation.term: atitiu tâkish â nitûchischâyihtâkiniwich â ihtikunikwâ mihkw chimâihch
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐊᑎᑎᐤ ᑖᑭᔥ ᐋ ᓂᑑᒋᔅᒑᔨᐦᑖᑭᓂᐎᒡ ᐋ ᐃᐦᑎᑯᓂᒀ ᒥᐦᒄ ᒋᒫᐃᐦᒡ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: a more thorough test to see if there’s blood in your stool

TermTranslation.term: etitû tekash e nânitûchischeyihtâkanuwihch e ihtakunikwe mihkw chimeihch
TermTranslation.term_syllabics: ᐁᑎᑑ ᑌᑲᔥ ᐁ ᓈᓂᑑᒋᔅᒉᔨᐦᑖᑲᓄᐎᐦᒡ ᐁ ᐃᐦᑕᑯᓂᑴ ᒥᐦᒄ ᒋᒣᐃᐦᒡ
TermTranslation.public_note_en: a more thorough test to see if there’s blood in your stool
